metadata.disclaimer: All pricing figures are realistic Mumbai market estimates compiled from verified local vendor offerings. These are not formal vendor quotes. Actual quotes may vary based on exact venue, dates, menu selections, and guest counts.

home.label: At Home or Society Clubhouse
home.notes: Society maintenance, lift electricity & post-party deep cleanup variable cost.
home.reducedSpec: Hosting at flat or building clubhouse with basic society maintenance deposit.

community_hall.label: Society / Community Hall
community_hall.notes: Rental for society clubhouse or municipal/sports complex hall in Mumbai suburbs.
community_hall.reducedSpec: Off-peak daytime slot or building society club room.

play_centre.label: Play Centre / Activity Venue (Funky Monkeys, Smaaash, etc.)
play_centre.notes: Per-child package including 2 hours soft play access, arcade credits, and party room host.
play_centre.reducedSpec: Non-weekend afternoon slot or reduced gaming credits.

digital.label: Digital / WhatsApp Video Invite
digital.notes: Custom animated Canva or graphic design invite distributed via WhatsApp.

printed.label: Custom Printed Themed Cards
printed.notes: Printed on 350gsm art card with thematic envelope and sticker seals.

items.name: Food & Catering Services
items.notes: Kids party menu (e.g. mini burgers, pasta station, pav bhaji/pizza, fries, beverage, cupcakes) with professional service staff.
items.reducedSpec: Smaller 3-item snack menu instead of multi-course buffet, self-service layout.

items.name: Decorations & Setup
items.notes: Balloon arch, themed photo backdrop, marquee number lights, and cake table decoration.
items.reducedSpec: Basic balloon bunch arrangement without personalized wooden cutouts or LED signage.

items.name: Return Gifts & Favors
items.notes: Curated return gift box (e.g., educational puzzle, stationery hamper, personalized drinkware).
items.reducedSpec: Standard stationery pouch / coloring book sourced from Crawford Market wholesale.

items.name: Custom Theme Props & Styling
items.notes: Themed paper goods, character photo props, custom birthday banner, and coordinated welcome signage.
items.reducedSpec: Standard color-palette styling instead of licensed character merchandise.

items.name: Activity Corner: Tattoo & Face Painting
items.notes: 3 hours with certified artist using skin-safe, non-toxic FDA approved colors & glitter.
items.reducedSpec: 2 hours coverage or tattoo stencils only.

items.name: Activity Corner: Carnival Games Stall
items.notes: Ring toss, mini bowling, bean bag toss, and Jenga with game coordinator and small participant prizes.
items.reducedSpec: 2 tabletop games managed by venue attendant without custom prize bucket.

items.name: Activity Corner: Build-Your-Own Pastry Station
items.notes: Cupcake/cookie decorating counter with disposable aprons, piping bags, colorful sprinkles, and dedicated helper.
items.reducedSpec: Pre-baked plain cookies with two frosting colors and sprinkles.

items.name: Activity Corner: Craft & Clay Station
items.notes: Bracelet making, air-dry clay sculpting, and canvas painting with take-home craft bags.
items.reducedSpec: Paper origami and card making station with basic supplies.

items.name: Activity Corner: Instant Photo Booth with Props
items.notes: Themed photo frame, funny props, instant mini-print or Polaroid print takeaway for guests.
items.reducedSpec: Selfie backdrop with hand props (guests use own phones).

items.name: Activity Corner: Slime & Sand Art Lab
items.notes: Sensory lab with glitter slime making and layered colored sand bottles with take-home containers.

items.name: Activity Corner: Live Popcorn & Candy Floss Stalls
items.notes: Live cart serving hot salted popcorn and pink spun candy floss for 2-3 hours.

items.name: Activity Corner: Treasure / Scavenger Hunt
items.notes: Clue scrolls, riddle maps, hidden tokens, and final treasure chest with medals/chocolates.
items.reducedSpec: DIY printed clue cards managed by host.

items.name: Professional Candid Photography
items.notes: 3 hours of dedicated candid event coverage, cake cutting highlights, and 50+ color-corrected high-res photos.
items.reducedSpec: 1.5 hours coverage focusing on cake cutting and family group portraits.

home.label: At Home or Society Clubhouse
home.notes: Society maintenance, lift electricity & post-party cleanup variable charges.
home.reducedSpec: Hosting in society flat or building clubhouse.

community_hall.label: Banquet Halls or Lawns
community_hall.notes: Air-conditioned banquet or terrace lawn rental in Mumbai scaled by headcount table.
community_hall.reducedSpec: Off-peak timing slot or community society hall.

play_centre.label: Restaurant or Activity Places
play_centre.notes: Turnkey private party dining room or indoor play centre package with basic decor & coordinator.
play_centre.reducedSpec: Standard dining package without extended play hours.

items.name: Catering & Refreshments
items.notes: Full-service multi-course banquet menu with live cooking stations.

items.name: Decorations, Stage & Floral Styling
items.notes: Stage backdrop, entrance arch, ambient lighting, and floral centerpieces.

items.name: Invitations & Announcements
items.notes: Digital video invitations and guest RSVP management.

items.name: Entertainment / Emcee / Music
items.notes: Professional event anchor / DJ / live performer.

items.name: Photography & Video Highlights
items.notes: Full celebration coverage with candid photos and short recap video.
